description: This file contains the implementation of a Hungarian matcher class used for object detection matching based on costs for class, bounding box, and GIoU, along with utility functions to build such matchers.

classes.name: HungarianMatcher
classes.description: A module that computes an assignment between predicted object locations and ground-truth labels using a cost-based Hungarian algorithm.

methods.name: __init__(self, cost_class: float = 1, cost_bbox: float = 1, cost_giou: float = 1)
methods.description: Constructor for the HungarianMatcher class, initializes cost weights for class, bounding box, and GIoU costs.

methods.name: forward(self, outputs, targets)
methods.description: Performs the matching between predictions and targets based on the specified costs using the Hungarian algorithm.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, cost_class: float = 1, cost_bbox: float = 1, cost_giou: float = 1):$/
ctags.signature: (self, cost_class: float = 1, cost_bbox: float = 1, cost_giou: float = 1)
